annotations.title: Test an automation on a sample customer

description: Runs the newest version of an automation once on a sample customer as a dry run: each step is recorded as what it would have done, and every message stays inside the test. payload lays trigger fields over the sample; fail_step runs the error branch as if that step had failed. Returns the run, whose steps are read through the run tools. It uses one automation run if it starts. A version that cannot be tested is refused in words.

fail_step.description: Optional. The id of a step: the test runs the error branch as if that step had failed, and shows what the branch would do. Refused when the automation has no error branch or no such step.

payload.description: Optional. Trigger subtrees (`message`, `order`, …) laid over the sample's, field by field.

name: test_automation
title: Test an automation on a sample customer
